mission.title: Universal Feelings, New Aesthetics
mission.body1: We study images, gestures, and immersive soundscapes to uncover the feelings that define our time — and we turn them into environments people can step inside. Liquid Art isn't a fixed style. It's a way of reading culture as it moves: fashion, sound, technology, and identity, dissolving into one continuous experience.
mission.body2: We believe meaning outlasts trend. Every exhibition, film, and track we release is a study of what a generation feels before it has the words for it.
mission.leadersSuffix: lead the vision of turning Liquid Art into the reference for experiences that make audiences feel culture, not just watch it.

brandStory.title: Why the Hashtag? Our Branding.
brandStory.body1: Nothing about culture today holds still. Genres blend, identities shift, and audiences move between the physical and the digital without noticing the seam. We named it Liquid because that's the only word honest enough to describe it.
brandStory.body2: #LiquidExpo is our signature and our thesis in one tag — a growing archive of exhibitions, artists, and ideas that refuse to sit inside a single category. Perhaps culture was always a flow. What we're building is the vocabulary for it.

manifesto.title: Meaning Over Money
manifesto.line1: To erase memory is to blind the mirrors in which humanity learns to recognize itself.
manifesto.body1: Digital museums are burning in silence — not from fire, but from neglect. Cultural intellectual property is disappearing faster than it's being protected, traded for attention instead of preserved for meaning.
manifesto.body2: Liquid Art exists to push back. We treat culture as heritage, not content. Every exhibition we stage is an act of digital memory-keeping, built for the artists and communities who created it — not the algorithms that profit from it.
manifesto.closing: Art changes people. People change the world.

founder.name: Carolina Damasceno
founder.title: Founder & Vision Holder
founder.bioLong: Carolina Damasceno is the founder and vision holder of #LiquidExpo, the creative force behind the Liquid Art movement. She leads a global constellation of artists, musicians, photographers, and technologists in building exhibitions that treat culture as a living, moving thing rather than a fixed product.
founder.bioLong2: Her work sits at the intersection of digital art, music, and fashion — curating experiences designed to make the invisible feelings of a generation visible, and unforgettable.
founder.bioShort: Carolina Damasceno — Founder of #LiquidExpo, curator of the Liquid Art movement.
